local_review.finding_body: The committed stats reported dynamicAccess as N/A even though the local evidence identified 27 non-zero dynamic-access call sites, so the new-library coverage gate lacked credible percentage evidence. Forge finalization regenerated the report as 27/27 covered (100%; reflection 25/25 and resources 2/2).
local_review.finding_title: Generated stats omit observed dynamic-access coverage
local_review.fix_note: Regenerated the coordinate statistics with Forge finalization, replacing the stale N/A dynamic-access value with the resolved 27/27 coverage report.
local_review.review_comment: Verified the single-coordinate closed file set, index shape, metadata-file format, and all test-contract musts. The tests are public, library-specific, version-agnostic, outside library packages, and contain no scaffold body, Native Image skip, swallowed failure, runtime class definition, legacy metadata, or JVM override. The FileSystemProvider future-defaults flag is narrowly justified: removing it reproducibly fails native-image because sshd-common registers RootedFileSystemProvider, while the stable finalization passed all three native lanes, metadata/style checks, and 27/27 dynamic-access coverage.
